description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the VacancyRestController within the OrangeHRM Recruitment Plugin. It contains tests for handling HTTP GET requests to retrieve vacancy data and tests that other methods throw NotImplementedException, indicating they are placeholders or unimplemented.

classes.name: VacancyRestControllerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the VacancyRestController handling recruitment vacancies. It tests retrieval of vacancy data and verifies unimplemented methods throw exceptions.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up test data before any tests are run, by populating fixture data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testHandleGetRequest
methods.description: Tests the handleGetRequest method of the controller with various IDs, verifying the returned vacancy data or catching exceptions for invalid or unavailable vacancies.
